# SoundTouchJS AudioWorklet

These browser files are copied from `@soundtouchjs/audio-worklet` 2.1.0:

- `SoundTouchNode.js`
- `constants.js`
- `soundtouch-processor.js`

They are licensed under MPL-2.0; see `LICENSE`. The processor is the package's
self-contained AudioWorklet build and does not need npm at runtime.

Upstream: <https://github.com/cutterbl/SoundTouchJS/tree/master/packages/audio-worklet>
